## 1、**DC07PE24**计算以双亲孩子表示法存储的树的深度

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
int PCTreeDepth(PCTree T) 
{    // Add your code here

    if (T.n==1||T.n==0) {
        return T.n;
    }
    int start=T.r;
    int len=1,orig=T.n-1,size=1,depth=1;
    int temp[100]={T.r};
    while (orig>0) {
        size=len;
        len=0;
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            PCTreeNode root=T.nodes[temp[i]];
            ChildNode *child=root.firstChild;
            while (child!=NULL) {
                temp[len++]=child->childIndex;
                child=child->nextChild;
            }
        }
        orig-=len;
        if (len==0) {
            return depth;
        }
        depth++;
    }

return depth;

}
```

## 2、**DC07PE26**计算以孩子-兄弟链表表示的树的深度

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
int dfs(CSTree a){
    if (a==NULL) {
        return 0;
    }

    if (a->firstChild==NULL) {
       int la=dfs(a->nextSibling);
       if (la==0) {
            return 1;
       }else {
            return la;
       }
    }else {
        int lr=dfs(a->firstChild);
        int la=dfs(a->nextSibling)-1;
        return (lr>la?lr:la)+1;
    }


}
int TreeDepth(CSTree T)
{   // Add your code here
    int depth=dfs(T);
return depth;

}
```

## 3、**DC07PE63**实现并查集带路径压缩的查找操作

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
int find(MFSet S, int i) 
{   // Add your code here

    int root=i;

    while (S.parent[root]!=-1) {
        root=S.parent[root];
    }
    while (i!=root) {
        int temp_parent=S.parent[i];
        S.parent[i]=root;
        i=temp_parent;
    }

    return root;

    
}
```
